problemRegister.rootCause: stale active authority after PR #200 merge
inbound WhatsApp events depended on in-memory sidecar history instead of persistence-before-acknowledgement
multi-step automations continue after failed steps and can report overall success
automation provider actions call the WhatsApp sidecar directly and bypass durable effect authority
sensitive AI actions use generic current-message confirmation rather than persisted exact proposal and approval
WhatsApp, courier and commerce effects use fragmented attempt, receipt and reconciliation semantics
commerce synchronization lacks durable run/item ingress, quarantine and operator recovery
an explicitly uncertified DHD adapter remains registered in normal provider execution authority
automation UI/API expose trigger and action combinations that have no committed producer or complete executable configuration
status-trigger payload wrote phone while the WhatsApp automation consumed customerPhone
daily report calls the sidecar directly and can duplicate after a successful send followed by marker persistence failure
inactive-shop worker ownership was implicit rather than contracted and tested
canonical courier implementation is split across current, reviewed-base and legacy layers
substantial provider adapter source is not equivalent to current live certification
installed hydrated-WebView proof remains open in issue #201

identityAndEncryption.ingressKey: provider + environment + exact account/workspace + exact shop incarnation + provider event/message identity
identityAndEncryption.effectKey: effect type + exact shop incarnation + canonical command/result identity + provider account/capability
identityAndEncryption.rule: sensitive raw provider payloads and requests are encrypted; logs and diagnostics contain bounded redacted metadata only

inbound.acknowledgement: the app acknowledges only after database commit; the sidecar removes a spool item only after that acknowledgement
inbound.publication: WebSocket and UI publication follows the database-committed result only

outbound.preEffectRecovery: lease expiry before provider call start is safe to retry
outbound.postEffectRecovery: after provider call start, receipt lookup or provider idempotency is required; otherwise outcome is ambiguous
outbound.operator: ambiguous retry requires an explicit duplicate-risk ceremony and immutable audit

automation.identity: stable trigger event identity + automation definition version
automation.stepPolicy: steps execute in declared order with explicit stop, continue or compensate policy
automation.truth: aggregate status is derived from persisted step states and can never report success after a failed required step
automation.effects: provider actions create shared durable effects and persist step-to-effect correlation
automation.catalog: only validated trigger/action schemas with a committed producer and complete configuration may be activated

ai.approval: one-time approval references the exact persisted proposal digest and cannot authorize regenerated arguments

workerOwnership.policy: only the exact active native runtime drains its shop database
workerOwnership.switch: native shop switch quiesces the process and workers before replacing the runtime
workerOwnership.inactiveShops: work remains durable and visibly pending in the inactive shop database

certification.authority: server-side capability certification and kill-switch state gate provider execution
certification.dhd: disabled in production until current live endpoint and behavior certification exists

experienceAndEvidence.diagnostics: redacted stable IDs, state transitions, attempts, error classes and receipt presence; no secrets or prohibited plaintext
